name: Выплатить наши долги
desc: За период своего существования Османская империя накопила большой долг, на восстановление нации тоже ушло немало средств. Сейчас у нас есть хорошая возможность выплатить часть долга!

name: Construct Siberian Redoubts
desc: We will construct more networks of underground fortifications on top of the ones we already have in our Siberian strongholds, ensuring that more of our people survive the inevitable.

name: Construct Finnish Redoubts
desc: It isn't enough that we turned the den of vipers known as Helsinki into a Russian city. Our work isn't complete until we integrate it and other key cities into our national redoubt. It'll ensure that the new Russian citizenry will survive the aftermath of the Great Trial§, as well as make any Teutonic attempt to strike back at us completely futile.

name: Construct Western Redoubts
desc: A large portion of our population and industry currently reside in western Russia. Lacking strong natural defenses, it's imperative that we build fortifications to protect our factories and laborers from enemy strikes and, in the worst case scenario, serve as forward frontline bases if the enemy breaks through our lines.

name: Construct Far-Eastern Redoubts
desc: Far beyond the reach of Germany's bombers, the Far East will be a major strongpoint for the rebuilding of our society after the Great Trial is complete. By creating additional underground redoubts in these areas, we'll ensure a future for our nation long after the bombs fall.
